originHint.text: Teacher-approved Production handoff. Prepared as dependency-blocked package until L270-L271 are in main.

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩休息不夠，坐在家中看起來精神變差、比較累，主角媽媽在旁邊關心。畫面要溫和，不要做成嚴重醫療場景；不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
sentences.imagePrompt: Use the approved L058 lesson images only as style references: warm modern children picture-book illustration, fine pencil-and-watercolor linework, soft natural light, detailed but clean Taiwan home/school/outdoor environments, expressive preschool proportions, bright warm palette, phone-readable square image / 1:1 composition. Do not copy any specific person from L058. Use protagonist family continuity from L154/L162/L163 and docs/LESSON_VISUAL_CAST_SOP.md: protagonist little girl with pink jacket or pink accents, white top, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip; protagonist mother in white or cream top, wide blue pants, shoulder-length dark hair; protagonist father in blue shirt or jacket, white top, khaki pants. Keep teacher, passersby, elders, and family members visually distinct. No visible text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brand marks, readable book covers, road signs, temple signs, deity text, wall writing, or UI text.
